meta.title: MASTER MODEL program tabs - equipment usage, constraint, velocity intent and session sequencing
meta.source: raw/MASTER_MODEL.xlsx (read-only, openpyxl); dumps/MASTER_MODEL/*.txt used for cross-checks
meta.item_evidence: name, sets_raw, reps_raw, load_raw, part, slot, cell = OBSERVED; implements, implement_category, constraint_level, velocity_*, tier, family, patterns, load_cues = INFERRED (rules in _classify.py)

evidence_legend.OBSERVED: value/label read from a cell (tab + cell given)
evidence_legend.SCIENCE: general training-science rationale, not from the sheet

constraint_scale.5: seated/lying, pad-supported, machine-guided path (leg press, leg ext/curl, machine row, machine dips/flies)
constraint_scale.4: guided OR supported: cable stations & cable isolation, Smith, lat pulldown, chest-supported/bench-supported free weight (seal row, preacher, floor skull crusher, tate press), 45-deg hyperextension, floor-supported core
constraint_scale.3: free weight bilateral with stable stance (barbell/hex/DB/KB squat, deadlift, bench, OHP, rows, curls, raises), pull-ups/push-ups/dips, planks
constraint_scale.2: low-constraint free weight: unilateral/split/staggered/offset/single-arm/half-kneeling, carries, swiss ball/slider, Olympic lifts, KB swings, push press/jerk, hanging & rotational core
constraint_scale.1: bodyweight ballistic/reactive: jumps, hops, bounds, depth drops, sprints & A-drills, medball throws/slams, plyo push-ups (incl. light DB/hex-loaded jumps)

velocity_scale.5: ballistic / max intent (throws, jumps, sprints, Oly, swings, push press, contrast)
velocity_scale.4: fast concentric with load or speed drill (FAST/same speed/banded DE, fast runners, powerful turns, A-skip/run)
velocity_scale.3: heavy / max effort (HEAVY, 1RIR main lifts, heavy max reps); A-march technique drill
velocity_scale.1: slow / isometric / eccentric (planks, holds, carries, slow tempo, iso holds)

tiers.T1_POWER: unloaded/light ballistic: medball, plyo, sprint, A-drills, depth drops, plyo push-ups
tiers.T2_POWER_STRENGTH: loaded ballistic & speed-strength: Olympic lifts & derivatives, KB swings/cleans, push press/jerk, loaded jumps, contrast complexes, dynamic-effort (FAST/banded/chained/same-speed) lifts
tiers.T4_RESISTANCE_PATTERN: other compound patterns: DB/KB/cable/machine/bodyweight compounds, all unilateral lower-body work, leg press/Smith
tiers.T5_ISOLATION: single-joint work (curls, extensions, raises, flies, leg ext/curl, calf raises, slider/swiss-ball hamstring)
tiers.CORE: control patterns / core (planks, anti-rotation, rotation, hanging core)

meta.claim_tested: power first (medball/plyo/sprint) -> power-strength (oly, contrast, loaded jumps) -> strength (heavy barbell/hex) -> resistance patterns (DB/KB/cable) -> isolation (machines/cables)
sequence_metric_notes: Only T1-T5 items enter the order tests; CORE, CONDITIONING, WARMUP, SKILL, PLACEHOLDER are reported by position only.
'monotonic' = no adjacent drop in tier rank; 'concordance' = share of all item pairs (i<j) with rank_i <= rank_j.
'excl_partD_ballistics' drops BASEBALL Part D ballistic accessories (ankle hops, hurdle hops, DB snatch in the calf/shoulder slot).
'adjusted' also re-tiers a jump paired straight after a heavy bilateral lift (e.g. 'Barbell deadlift' + 'Broad jumps') as one T2 contrast pair.
Row order is treated as execution order. That is OBSERVED for BASEBALL (Part A-E) and INFERRED elsewhere.
meta.counting_unit: line item = one exercise cell in one session column; repeated weeks/levels are counted each time they are written
